scope: repository P2 configs, runners, reports, and tests; artifacts, submissions, and raw data excluded

selected_axis.single_change: append a masked temperature-1 log-mean-exp of the 32 element-embedding coordinates to the exact v13 masked mean, masked maximum, and context before the unchanged head
selected_axis.historical_support: v13 executed all three prefix-purged folds; every selected scoring row uses the finite organizer-distributed public-token mask and the fixed log-mean-exp descriptor has an exact zero fallback when support is absent; training rows are 45935, 119667, and 149384
selected_axis.identity_initialization: the new 32 head columns are exactly zero and the original 75 head columns are copied, so the initial function equals v13

distinctions.v15: v15 learns token-token self-attention before pooling; v49 has no attention and uses one fixed coordinatewise symmetric log-mean-exp statistic
distinctions.v16: v16 passes physical-depth graph messages; v49 has no graph, adjacency, depth kernel, or message passing
distinctions.v20: v20 aligns centered latent covariances across months as a loss; v49 adds no alignment or auxiliary loss
distinctions.v43: v43 applies target-layer FiLM inside token embeddings; v49 does not condition the element encoder on target layer
distinctions.v45_v45c: v45 and v45c stochastically mask Linear weights during training; v49 is deterministic and changes only the pooled descriptor
distinctions.v46: v46 applies LayerNorm to hidden activations; v49 has no normalization
distinctions.v47: v47 learns CrossNet interactions among already pooled coordinates; v49 has no cross layer
distinctions.v48: v48 pools the uncentered diagonal second moment mean(z^2); v49 instead pools log(mean(exp(z))) at one fixed temperature and contains no products or bilinear statistic

primary_source.citation: Zaheer et al., Deep Sets, NeurIPS 2017
primary_source.claim: symmetric aggregation provides a permutation-invariant representation of a set
primary_source.use: representation motivation only; no P2 performance or hyperparameter transfer
